senses.gloss: (cmp. חגב, חגס) a species of wild bees, or locusts.
units: Sabb. 106ᵇ הצד חגבים ח׳ וכ׳ Ms. O. (Alf. ed. Const. חִיגְזִין, Rashi הֲגָ׳, ed. גזין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) if one catches (on the Sabbath) locusts, ḥăgazin &c.; Y. ib. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ חגיין ותושין, read חגזין ויתושין.—

<cite ref="Bekhorot 7b:8">Bekh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>דבש הגזין והצירעין</he> (= <he>הַה׳</he>, cmp. <cite ref="E00636"><he>הֶמְסֵס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:4">Makhsh. VI, 4</cite> <cite ref="E00064"><he>הגזין</he></cite> omitted) the honey of &c.
